entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this useless VeloBand Pulse monitor. I've been trying to do it online and your system is a nightmare. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you've had trouble with the website. Could I get your full name and order number to start?
It's Alex Rodriguez, order number 788-B45. Just get it done. I don't have all day.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

What does it matter? The issue is that I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** for a New Year's resolution that's already dead. I **don't use it** and I want my money back. Are you going to process this or do I need to talk to your manager and plaster this all over social media?
No, no, that won't be necessary. I can absolutely handle this for you. I understand completely. Let me just review the return eligibility for your item.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've just checked our policy, and it looks like items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 17, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Well, finally! So you're sending me a return label?

Yes, of course. I've just processed the return authorization. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on your account. Just place the band back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 5 to 7 business days. You'll get an email confirmation as soon as it's processed.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Alex. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
